verdict: Memory supercycle 2027 leg forming (TrendForce HBM multiples-higher call); MRVL +33% on Jensen endorsement; AVGO -15% guide miss reset SOX but capex intact — overall mixed-to-bull week.
body_md:
## Fresh Developments (Last 24-72h)

**Signal 1 — DRAM/HBM Pricing: ACCELERATING BULLISH**
TrendForce (Jun 1-2): 1Q26 DRAM industry revenue +81% QoQ; conventional DRAM ASPs +~95% QoQ. 2Q26 guide: conventional DRAM +58-63% QoQ, NAND +70-75% QoQ — memflation re-accelerating. **Key new signal (Jun 2):** TrendForce now projects HBM contract prices will "surge multiples higher" in 2027 as suppliers seize absolute pricing power. HBM profitability in 1Q26 was overtaken by DDR5 RDIMM for the first time, forcing suppliers to reprice HBM sharply upward for 2027 negotiation cycles.

**Signal 2 — HBM4 Ramp / Correction Risk: BASELINE BEING CHALLENGED**
SK Hynix delayed HBM4 scale-up from Q2 to Q3 2026 — extended HBM3E demand consuming fab capacity. Micron began volume shipping HBM4 36GB 12H for NVIDIA Vera Rubin (>2.8 TB/s); sold out through 2026. NVIDIA Rubin Ultra targets 384GB HBM/GPU in 2027, amplifying bit demand. The baseline "correction after 2026" thesis is under direct revision — TrendForce's multiples-higher 2027 HBM ASP call inverts the correction risk.

**Signal 3 — Hyperscaler AI Capex: STABLE/RISING, NO GUIDE-DOWNS**
2026 capex: Google $175-190B, Amazon $200B, Microsoft $190B, Meta $115-135B = ~$700-715B combined. NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 guide $91B (+85% YoY) — fastest ramp in company history. Intel +8.5% on new Alphabet contract. No first guide-down detected.

**Signal 4 — AMD/Custom ASIC: QUIET**
AMD Helios + MI400 still on track for 2H-2026 per Feb 2026 guidance. OpenAI committed ~2GW of AWS Trainium capacity (Trainium3+4). No material new news in last 72h.

**Signal 5 — Optical/Photonics: QUIET**
No new 72h catalysts. NVIDIA $4B Coherent+Lumentum commitment (Mar 2026) remains anchor. InP constraints: demand 2x supply, lead times 18-24 months, unchanged. CPO <1% penetration through 2027; scale-out transceivers first.

**Signal 6 — Solar: MIXED / BINARY RISK AHEAD**
Solar stocks +40% YTD (UBS basket). ENPH +54% past month. FSLR gained on Supreme Court striking IEEPA "reciprocal" tariffs. FSLR also down 7.9% recently on Section 45X policy uncertainty + insider concern. **Watch:** Section 232 tariff decision looming mid-to-late June — binary for importers, potential tailwind for FSLR (domestic). Utility-scale demand resilient; residential still challenged.

**Signal 7 — Watchlist: ACTIVE WEEK**

| Name | Move | Catalyst |
|------|------|----------|
| MRVL | **+33%** (Jun 2) | Jensen Huang at COMPUTEX called Marvell "next trillion-dollar company"; NVIDIA invested $2B in Marvell collaboration |
| AVGO | **-15%** (Jun 4-5) | Q2 FY26 beat but Q3 AI chip guide $16B vs $17.2B est.; no full-year $100B raise; rippled entire SOX -10.3% |
| MU | -11.5% → +9% rebound | Caught in AVGO-led SOX panic; rebounded; near ATH ~$1,040; Goldman 2x PT; June 24 earnings next catalyst |
| NVDA | -7% → recovering | AVGO sector contagion; Q2 FY27 $91B guide intact |
| AMD | -10.9% (Jun 5) | SOX selloff; Helios 2H-2026 unchanged |
| FSLR | +5% (Feb ruling) / -7.9% recent | Supreme Court IEEPA ruling positive; Section 232 June decision is live binary |

## Context vs. Baseline

The AVGO guide miss (~$1B below elevated buy-side whispers) triggered the sharpest SOX single-day decline since 2020. However, AVGO maintained full-year $100B+ FY27 AI target and beat on revenue/EPS — this is an expectations reset, not a broken demand cycle. Hyperscaler capex prints remain uncut. The TrendForce HBM 2027 multiples-higher projection is the most structurally significant update: the baseline's primary risk factor (post-2026 correction) is now contested by supply/demand fundamentals pointing the other way.

## Signals Flashing

| Signal | Direction | Bull/Bear |
|--------|-----------|-----------|
| DRAM/HBM contract pricing | Accelerating | **Bull** — 2Q26 DRAM +63% QoQ; HBM 2027 multiples higher |
| HBM4 correction risk | Inverting | **Bull** — structural 2027 HBM supercycle forming, not crashing |
| Hyperscaler AI capex | Stable | **Bull** — $700B+ intact, no guide-downs |
| Custom ASIC share shift | Gradual | Neutral |
| Optical/photonics | Constrained | **Bull** — InP scarcity, CPO early innings |
| Solar policy | Volatile | **Mixed** — 40% YTD but Section 232 binary risk mid-June |
| Watchlist catalysts | Active | **Mixed** — MRVL +33% bull; AVGO -15% near-term reset |

## Most Important Development

**TrendForce June 2, 2026:** HBM contract prices projected to "surge multiples higher" in 2027 — the single most important update this week because it directly challenges the baseline's primary bear signal. DDR5 crowding out HBM capacity, NVIDIA Rubin Ultra's 384GB/GPU demand, and active 2027 HBM4 supply negotiations are converging into a second memory supercycle leg. The SK Hynix "correction after 2026" warning from the baseline now looks like a minority view vs. TrendForce's structural bull thesis.

*Not investment advice. Forward figures are forecasts.*
